Mode: Compressed block entry decoding and metadata-only consistency checks
Notes: 12-byte compressed entry decoded as LE offset[5], compressed size[3], uncompressed size[3], compression method index[1]
Offsets are within .ucas logical data and are NOT compared to .utoc file length
Method index 0 denotes uncompressed; positive method indexes must be within declared method count
Decreasing offsets are reported as consistency anomalies, not necessarily proof of corruption across partitions
Sample output includes all region-intersecting pakchunk300 entries, capped at 100000 rows
